title: Who may mint a capability, and what a delegation may not widen
note: Every mutation here removes one link in the chain between 'this actor wrote a record' and 'this actor had the authority to'. The ledger recorded the first for a long time and refused to check the second, which is attribution rather than authorization -- so these are the checks that turned issuer_of() from a label into a gate.
